the type of protein preparation used, as well as conditions of enzymatic hydrolysation influenced the properties of the obtained hydrolysates.
the potato protein hydrolysates obtained by enzymatic hydrolyse were characterised by high content of free amino acids and good amino acid composition.

the type of protein preparations used and conditions of their enzymatic modification influenced the properties of hydrolysates obtained, which were characterized by similar chemical and AA compositions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of the method of obtaining protein preparations from potato juice and of enzymatic hydrolysation on their chemical and amino acid composition.
a search for the best technological conditions to obtain potato protein hydrolysates with a favourable amino acids composition.
a possibility of using the potato protein preparations obtained through their thermal precipitation in the food industry, mainly in the production of food protein hydrolysates.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the type of protein preparation used and the conditions of enzymatic hydrolysing influence the properties of the protein hydrolysates obtained and the use of two hydrolytic enzymes is recommended.

the hydrolysis of the potato protein preparations obtained in the laboratory conditions with the use of endopeptide and exopeptide enzymes was effective and the obtained hydrolysates were of high quality.

the preparation obtained through the coagulation of potato proteins with calcium lactate is the most suitable for the enzymatic hydrolytic modification and the application of two enzymes is the most favourable for the production of hydrolysates with the highest proteolysis efficiency.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the application of two enzymes during enzymatic hydrolytic process was more advantageous than using only one enzyme.
the application of the enzymatic modification of the potato protein preparations obtained in our study is a promising way of obtaining hydrolysates with a high content of essential amino acids.

the use of calcium salts in the technology of obtaining the protein preparations and the application of endopep-tidase enzyme are recommended for the preparation of hydrolysates with the highest content of free amino acids.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the type of enzyme used and its concentration in the reaction medium significantly influence the chemical and amino-acid composition of the hydrolysed potato preparations.

the use of the two enzymes in hydrolysis of the potato protein preparations obtained with different technologies is more effective and leads to the production of hydrolysates with better chemical and amino acid properties.

the use of exopeptidases in enzymatic hydrolyses of potato protein preparations is a good solution to obtain hydrolysates with a good content of free amino acids and with the amino acid composition similar to that of egg protein.
